compiled_state.title: [skill:fix-cascade-recovery]: CI test-doc-migration.sh fails -> shim-form violation in SKILL.md script invocation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

CI Script Tests job fails on PR #21 (commit d5af16f3c8). Single failure:

```
=== test-doc-migration.sh ===
FAIL: test_no_legacy_plugin_root_refs
  expected: 0
  actual:   1
```

## Reproduction

`bash tests/scripts/test-doc-migration.sh` — fails locally and in CI.

## Offending line

`plugins/dso/skills/fix-cascade-recovery/SKILL.md` Step 3:

    bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/fix-cascade-recovery/reset-cascade-counter.sh"

The test enforces that script invocations from skills/, docs/workflows/, and CLAUDE.md use the `.claude/scripts/dso <name>` shim form rather than the `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/` env-var form (excluded patterns: `PLUGIN_SCRIPTS=` assignments and `ls` listings).

This line was introduced in this session by the /skill-refactor of fix-cascade-recovery (commit 4c68eef039).
